title: Pure Magnet Warrior
summary: Magnet Warrior cards with the 2026 Conduction Warrior and Flux Ochsenfeld Rock Fusions that came with them, plus generic staples. The Electromagnet Warriors search a Magnet Warrior or a Magna Warrior and tag into a Level 4 from the Deck on the opponent's turn. The Burst Protocol cards lead: Sigma Minus Fusion Summons from the hand and mills a Magna Warrior, and Tellusion then rises from the GY by banishing both Sigmas. Omega Plus flips a monster face-down on either turn, and Magnet Bonding searches a Magnet Warrior or Magna Warrior, or Fusion Summons by shuffling Rocks back. The classic Alpha, Beta and Gamma one-ofs are the Level 4 tag targets and Valkyrion's materials.
